notes: Initial fit: strong. Looking to add LLM-driven doc search + field tech support assistant for service teams.
POC started Oct 2024: baseline embeddings job + chat flow for triage. SE delivered proof-of-concept infra config (dedicated pool).
Milestones: tokenized docs ingestion (done), embedding pipeline smoke tests (done), chat UI integrated to staging (blocked).
Dec 04 call: security team raised concerns about key management and data residency. Asked for HSM/KMS architecture diagram. SE provided diagram 2024-12-09.
Quote from Head of Platforms: "We need a KMS/HSM integration that keeps keys in our VPC — cannot use vendor-managed keys."
Mid-Dec: internal headcount freeze; infra team reallocated to ERP migration. POC milestone (latency tuning + canary) missed. No clear ETA from engineering manager.
AE attempted outreach: 3 emails + 2 calls since 2025-01-02. Very low response. CSM not yet assigned (pre-revenue).
Profile: risk-averse, long procurement cycles. Prefers on-prem or customer-managed keys. Cost sensitivity moderate; will pay for SLA if security boxes checked.

Technical notes: target 95th percentile latency <120ms for chat queries at 50 RPS; embedding throughput target 500 docs/min. Current staging meets functional correctness but latency not tuned for dedicated GPU configs.

Sales posture: pipeline flagged as at-risk — moving to 'stalled'. Short-term options discussed: 1) scoped mini-POC (chat only) using customer VPC and KMS proof; 2) hold until security sign-off; 3) handoff to channel partner for on-prem pilot.
Current status: POC environment exists but nightly runs stopped after infra team pulled staff. No active tickets for performance tuning. Security team still evaluating HSM proposal.
Suggested next actions (from AE): re-open if security gives greenlight OR if engineering capacity returns. Consider offering funded pilot to keep momentum.
Why lost/risk: no internal champion + budget freeze; if competitor shows quicker path to customer-managed KMS, risk of slip to competitor increases.
